name: Knowledge Graph Memory (MCP)
author: JARVIS Core
description: Official MCP memory server (npx): persistent knowledge-graph memory across sessions — entities, relations and observations the assistant can grow over time.
capabilities: store entities and facts as a knowledge graph
recall across sessions — the graph persists on disk

examples.phrase: remember that my editor is VS Code
examples.reply: The memory server stores an 'editor' entity linked to you with a uses relation.
